finalOnlyObservation: Every native final generation reports14 output tokens; every structured final24. Twelve final-only generations each; delta10 per turn,120 total. Final JSON body envelope and escaping are the visible format difference. No within-response token attribution available, so not a tokenizer proof assigning each token to punctuation.

toolBearingObservation.structuralDifference: Structured usually emits Python printing formatted JSON with escaped quotes and numeric formatting; native usually prints count and sum directly. Revision calculations also differ. Model-selected tool programs were not constrained identical.
toolBearingObservation.caution: 554 is tool-bearing response output delta, not an exact token attribution solely to program text; first round also contains commentary. It is not Room protocol overhead or evidence schema caused the different tool programs.
